status_legend.in_progress: The feature is the current active task (only one allowed).
status_legend.blocked: Work cannot continue until a documented blocker is resolved.
status_legend.passing: Verification command ran, exited successfully, and evidence is recorded. Irreversible.

sections.dashboard: Ticker-driven company dashboard with context, key stats, and charts.
sections.valuation: Calculator workspace covering DCF, DDM, RIM, comps, and scenario tooling.
sections.ai: AI fundamental analysis that follows the qualitative-to-scenario analyst framework.
sections.ux: Cross-cutting user-experience behavior shared across sections.

kinds.e2e: Frontend Playwright spec in frontend/e2e/, runs against a live frontend and backend.
kinds.backend: pytest suite in backend/tests/ that hits FastAPI endpoints.
kinds.frontend-unit: Vitest or Jest spec in frontend/src/**/__tests__/.
kinds.manual: Human-executed verification steps, used only when an automated path is not yet feasible.

evidence_shape.commit: Git SHA of the commit that satisfied the feature.

features.title: Search and select a company by ticker
features.behavior: A user enters a ticker and the dashboard workspace loads for that company.

verification.command: cd frontend && npx playwright test e2e/dash-001.spec.ts
manual_steps: Run ./init.sh, then start the backend and frontend using the dev commands from the startup summary.
Open the app in a browser.
Enter AAPL in the search input and submit.
Verify the dashboard workspace for Apple loads.

features.notes: Foundation feature. All other dashboard, valuation, and AI features depend on the workspace route existing.

features.title: Display company identity and key-stats card
features.behavior: The workspace shows the company's name, ticker, sector, current price, market cap, and a concise business summary.

verification.command: cd frontend && npx playwright test e2e/dash-002.spec.ts
manual_steps: Load the AAPL dashboard.
Verify name, ticker, and sector are shown.
Verify price and market cap are shown.
Verify a business summary paragraph is shown.

features.title: Show market and industry context indices
features.behavior: The workspace shows the S&P 500 and a relevant industry index alongside the company price.

verification.command: cd frontend && npx playwright test e2e/dash-003.spec.ts
manual_steps: Load the AAPL dashboard.
Verify the S&P 500 value and daily change are visible.
Verify an industry index relevant to the sector is visible.
Switch to a company in a different sector and verify the industry index updates.

features.notes: Industry index follows the company's GICS sector or industry group.

features.title: Display key financial metrics
features.behavior: The workspace shows revenue, EPS, free cash flow, gross and operating margins, and ROIC (or ROE) for the selected company.

verification.command: cd frontend && npx playwright test e2e/dash-004.spec.ts
manual_steps: Load the AAPL dashboard.
Open the key metrics section.
Verify revenue, EPS, and free cash flow are shown.
Verify at least one margin and one return metric (ROIC or ROE) are shown.

features.notes: ROIC is preferred so DCF work can link growth to value creation.

features.title: Render revenue-to-net-income waterfall chart
features.behavior: The dashboard shows a waterfall chart that walks from revenue through COGS, OpEx, interest, tax, and other items to net income.

verification.command: cd frontend && npx playwright test e2e/dash-005.spec.ts
manual_steps: Load the AAPL dashboard.
Locate the waterfall chart.
Verify the chart starts at revenue and ends at net income.
Verify intermediate bars (COGS, OpEx, interest, tax) are labeled and signed correctly.
Switch to a different company and verify the chart updates.

features.title: Render revenue segment breakdown
features.behavior: The dashboard shows how total revenue splits across the company's reporting segments, reconciling to total revenue.

verification.command: cd frontend && npx playwright test e2e/dash-006.spec.ts
manual_steps: Load the AAPL dashboard.
Locate the revenue breakdown chart.
Verify segment names and values reconcile to total revenue.
Switch to a single-segment company and verify the chart handles it gracefully.

features.notes: Falls back gracefully when the data source does not expose segment detail.

features.title: Render historical financial trend charts
features.behavior: The dashboard shows multi-year history charts for revenue, earnings, and cash flow.

verification.command: cd frontend && npx playwright test e2e/dash-007.spec.ts
manual_steps: Load the AAPL dashboard.
Navigate to the historical trends section.
Verify revenue, earnings, and cash flow charts render.
Switch companies and verify the charts update.

features.title: DCF calculator math with manual inputs
features.behavior: A user opens the DCF calculator, manually enters revenue growth, margin, WACC, and terminal growth, and sees projected FCF and intrinsic value per share.

verification.command: cd backend && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/test_val_001a.py -q
manual_steps: Open the DCF calculator for AAPL.
Enter revenue growth, margin, WACC, and terminal growth.
Verify projected FCF and intrinsic value per share are computed.
Change WACC and verify the intrinsic value updates.

features.notes: Pure math layer first. Backend pytest covers the math; val-001b adds the auto-fetched baseline.

features.title: DCF auto-fetched baseline assumptions
features.behavior: Opening the DCF calculator prefills revenue growth, margins, WACC inputs, and terminal growth from company data, and the user can override any value.

verification.command: cd frontend && npx playwright test e2e/val-001b.spec.ts
manual_steps: Open the DCF calculator for AAPL.
Verify baseline assumptions are prefilled.
Override one assumption and verify the projection and intrinsic value recompute.
Override WACC and terminal growth and verify the intrinsic value updates.

features.notes: Projection logic ties growth and reinvestment to ROIC so growth only creates value when ROIC exceeds WACC.

features.title: DDM calculator for dividend-paying companies
features.behavior: A user can run a dividend discount model for a dividend payer, override dividend growth and cost of equity, and see intrinsic value per share; non-payers show a clear message.

verification.command: cd frontend && npx playwright test e2e/val-002.spec.ts
manual_steps: Open the DDM calculator for a dividend payer such as KO.
Verify baseline dividend, growth, and cost of equity are prefilled.
Override growth or cost of equity and verify the intrinsic value updates.
Open the DDM for a non-dividend-paying company and verify a clear non-applicable message is shown.

features.title: Residual Income Model calculator
features.behavior: A user can run a RIM valuation based on book value plus present value of residual income, override ROE forecast and cost of equity, and compare the result against the DCF output.

verification.command: cd frontend && npx playwright test e2e/val-003.spec.ts
manual_steps: Open the RIM calculator for AAPL.
Verify baseline book value, ROE forecast, and cost of equity are prefilled.
Override the ROE forecast and verify residual income and intrinsic value update.
Verify the result is shown alongside the DCF result.

features.notes: Useful when near-term free cash flow is negative or hard to forecast.

features.title: Relative valuation with peer comparables
features.behavior: A user sees the company's EV/EBITDA, P/E, and P/B alongside a peer set with their multiples and an implied price range from peer medians.

verification.command: cd frontend && npx playwright test e2e/val-004.spec.ts
manual_steps: Open the relative valuation section for AAPL.
Verify the company's EV/EBITDA, P/E, and P/B are shown.
Verify at least three peers are listed with their multiples.
Verify an implied price range from peer medians is displayed.

features.notes: Peer set starts from sector/industry matching; refinable later.

features.title: Bull, base, and bear scenario cases
features.behavior: A user can toggle between bull, base, and bear scenarios for the active model, each with distinct editable assumptions and its own intrinsic value, and view the three side by side.

verification.command: cd frontend && npx playwright test e2e/val-005.spec.ts
manual_steps: Open the DCF calculator for AAPL.
Switch between bull, base, and bear scenarios.
Verify each scenario has distinct, editable assumptions.
Verify each scenario produces its own intrinsic value.
Verify a side-by-side comparison view is available.

features.title: Sensitivity grid across key assumptions
features.behavior: A user sees a two-variable sensitivity grid (for example WACC vs terminal growth) that recomputes when a core assumption changes.

verification.command: cd frontend && npx playwright test e2e/val-006.spec.ts
manual_steps: Open the DCF calculator for AAPL.
Locate the sensitivity grid.
Verify the grid shows a matrix across two assumption axes.
Change a core assumption and verify the grid recomputes.

features.title: Save and reload valuation scenarios
features.behavior: A user can save a named valuation scenario and reload it later with all assumptions restored after a browser reload or app restart.

verification.command: cd frontend && npx playwright test e2e/val-007.spec.ts
manual_steps: Open the DCF calculator for AAPL.
Change several assumptions and save the scenario with a name.
Reload the page or restart the app.
Reopen the saved scenario and verify the assumptions are restored.

features.notes: Persistence mechanism (local storage vs backend DB with accounts) to be decided before implementation.

features.title: AI industry dynamics analysis
features.behavior: A user can generate an AI analysis of the company's industry dynamics covering macro environment, regulation, and competitive intensity.

verification.command: cd backend && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/test_ai_001a.py -q
manual_steps: Open the AI analysis panel for AAPL.
Trigger industry dynamics generation.
Verify the response covers macro environment, regulation, and competitive intensity.

features.notes: Step 1 of 3 in the Qualitative Foundation framework.

features.title: AI business model and moat analysis
features.behavior: A user can generate an AI analysis of the company's business model and durable competitive advantage.

verification.command: cd backend && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/test_ai_001b.py -q
manual_steps: Open the AI analysis panel for AAPL.
Trigger business model and moat generation.
Verify the response names the revenue model and identifies moat sources (switching costs, network effects, cost advantage, or intangible assets).

features.notes: Step 2 of 3 in the Qualitative Foundation framework.

features.title: AI management quality and capital allocation analysis
features.behavior: A user can generate an AI analysis of management quality focused on capital allocation history (reinvestment, buybacks, acquisitions).

verification.command: cd backend && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/test_ai_001c.py -q
manual_steps: Open the AI analysis panel for AAPL.
Trigger management quality generation.
Verify the response discusses reinvestment decisions, buyback timing, and acquisition history.

features.notes: Step 3 of 3 in the Qualitative Foundation framework.

features.title: AI financial scrubbing and forecast drivers
features.behavior: A user can generate an AI analysis that lists normalization adjustments to reported financials and identifies the unit-economics drivers behind forecast growth.

verification.command: cd backend && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/test_ai_002.py -q
manual_steps: Trigger financial scrubbing analysis for AAPL.
Verify the response lists non-recurring items and suggested adjustments.
Verify the response identifies industry-appropriate unit-economics drivers.
Verify the adjustments can be fed into the DCF or RIM baseline.

features.notes: Follows the Financial Scrubbing and Forecasting step of the framework.

features.title: AI valuation ensemble triangulation
features.behavior: A user can generate an AI summary that reconciles DCF, RIM, and peer-comp results into a triangulated target range and explains which model anchors the view.

verification.command: cd backend && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/test_ai_003.py -q
manual_steps: Run DCF, RIM, and comps for AAPL.
Open the AI valuation synthesis panel.
Verify the response references the numerical outputs of each model.
Verify the response explains which model is weighted most and why.
Verify a triangulated intrinsic value range is produced.

features.notes: Follows the Core Valuation Engines step of the framework.

features.title: AI scenario and catalyst analysis
features.behavior: A user can generate AI bull, base, and bear narratives with their driving assumptions and a list of upcoming catalysts with approximate timing.

verification.command: cd backend && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/test_ai_004.py -q
manual_steps: Trigger scenario analysis for AAPL.
Verify the response contains distinct bull, base, and bear narratives.
Verify each narrative names the key assumption changes (growth, margin, WACC).
Verify upcoming catalysts (earnings, launches, regulatory events) are listed with timing.

features.notes: Follows the Scenario Analysis and Stress Testing step of the framework.

features.title: Evidence grounding across AI analyses
features.behavior: Every AI analysis exposes the underlying data points or citations behind each major claim; unsupported claims are flagged or suppressed.

verification.command: cd backend && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/test_ai_005.py -q
manual_steps: Generate any AI analysis for AAPL.
Open the evidence or citations view.
Verify each major claim links to a data point, filing reference, or source.
Verify the evidence shown matches the selected company.
Verify unsupported claims are flagged or suppressed.

features.title: Handle loading, invalid tickers, and API failures gracefully
features.behavior: Every data-fetching surface shows clear loading states and understandable error messages instead of blank screens or crashes.

verification.command: cd frontend && npx playwright test e2e/ux-001.spec.ts
manual_steps: Search for a valid ticker and verify a loading indicator appears while data is fetched.
Search for an invalid ticker and verify a clear error message is shown.
Simulate a backend failure on the dashboard, the calculator, and the AI panel.
Verify each surface shows a recoverable error state instead of crashing.

features.notes: Enforced as each data-fetching feature lands rather than retrofitted at the end.
